How confidence is setIt follows the kind of evidence, not judgement.
  • The customer's own statement (high confidence at most): The organisation says so itself: its press release, website, annual report or a named executive on the record.
  • Regulatory or securities filing (high confidence at most): A filing by the customer or the vendor names the relationship.
  • Independent press (high confidence at most): Editorially independent reporting describes the deployment.
  • Joint announcement (medium confidence at most): A press release issued with the vendor, usually with a quote from the customer.
  • Vendor case study (medium confidence at most): The vendor's published customer story naming the organisation.
  • Vendor mention only (low confidence at most): A logo, a customer list or a passing mention by the vendor, with nothing from the customer.
  • An organisation that also holds a stake in the vendor is labelled “Investor and customer” and is never rated above medium.
  • A partnership is listed as a partner, not a customer.

Questions to ask the vendor (6)

  1. How many full-time employees does Cognition have, and how many work in engineering, security and customer support?
    Headcount indicates capacity to support a large bank deployment.
  2. What is Cognition's total equity funding to date and its current cash runway?
    Total capital raised indicates financial resilience.
  3. Can Cognition provide audited financial statements or equivalent evidence of financial standing under NDA?
    Audited or publicly reported financials let a bank assess the vendor's standing.
  4. Has Cognition or the former Windsurf business had any security incident affecting customer code or credentials in the last three years, and how was it disclosed?
    Security incidents bear on the reputational exposure of a bank that relies on the vendor.
  5. Have any enterprise customers left Devin or the former Windsurf product in the last 24 months, and why?
    Customer departures bear on the reputational exposure of a bank that relies on the vendor.
  6. Have there been any senior leadership departures or governance disputes at Cognition since the Windsurf acquisition?
    Leadership changes or disputes bear on the reputational exposure of a bank that relies on the vendor.

Timeline

  1. 2026-09-08 · funding Cognition
    Cognition raises more than $2bn Series E at $48bn valuation

    Cognition announced a Series E of more than $2bn at a $48bn valuation led by Andreessen Horowitz and Accel, with Founders Fund, General Catalyst and Avenir returning. It said run-rate revenue had grown from $492M in May to almost $900M and named Citi among Devin customers.   5. 2025-08-05 · layoff Cognition
    Cognition reported to lay off 30 staff and offer buyouts after Windsurf deal

    Reported by TechCrunch on 2025-08-05, citing The Information: Cognition laid off 30 employees about three weeks after acquiring Windsurf and offered the roughly 200 remaining Windsurf employees a buyout of nine months' salary. SiliconANGLE reported on 2026-09-08 that roughly 200 employees remained after the August 2025 layoff of 30 staff. TechCrunch (independent press, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)SiliconANGLE (independent press, retrieved 2026-11-20, opens in new tab)

  6. 2025-07-14 · acquisition Cognition
    Cognition signs agreement to acquire Windsurf

    Cognition announced a definitive agreement to acquire Windsurf's intellectual property, agentic IDE product, trademark, brand and team. No price was given. The announcement cited $82M of annual recurring revenue and more than 350 enterprise customers for Windsurf. SiliconANGLE later reported that the deal followed a collapsed OpenAI bid and Google's hiring of Windsurf's founders.
